title: There is no writing correctly. Grammar, while improving writing, can also act as a tool for oppression of people and poetry creativity and community L
summary: There is no writing correctly. Grammar, while improving writing, can also act as a tool for oppression of people and poetry creativity and community Let us devour rules and burp up exceptions from within #smallpoems #edu305
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
There is no writing correctly. Grammar, while improving writing, can also act as a tool for oppression

of people
and poetry
creativity and community
Let us devour rules
and burp up exceptions
from within
#smallpoems
#edu305
